title: Implement ConstitutiveModel ABC
objective: Create the ConstitutiveModel abstract base class in symbolic/constitutive.py to provide a unified interface for all material models (hyperelastic and dissipative).

plan_assets.asset_description: ConstitutiveModel ABC class definition with abstract methods

implementation_steps: Read the current stub at symbolic/constitutive.py (1-line docstring)
Implement ConstitutiveModel ABC with 5 abstract methods: pk2_stress, material_tangent, voigt_tangent, state_variables (property), is_dissipative (property)
Use **state kwargs pattern for flexible state variable passing
Add type hints and docstrings per .claude/rules/symbolic.md
acceptance_criteria: ABC defines all 5 abstract methods with correct signatures
ABC cannot be instantiated directly (raises TypeError)
risks: ConstitutiveModel ABC is too rigid for future models. Mitigation: Use **state kwargs pattern to allow flexible state variable passing without prescribing a specific state container.
